atoms.description: For this task, the complete video_filter_top and all dependencies have fixed DATA_WIDTH=24, IMAGE_WIDTH=384, IMAGE_HEIGHT=64, BLINK_RATE=6, DEBOUNCE_LIMIT=2500000. RGB is R[23:16],G[15:8],B[7:0]. All inputs are stable before the rising edge of clk; there is no ready/backpressure. btn[3:2] has no effect. IMAGE_HEIGHT does not limit the text y counter; the top-level DEBOUNCE_LIMIT does not change the fixed 2500000 sampling limit in each submodule.
atoms.timing: All sequential state updates only on the rising edge of clk, and outputs settle after the edge. sw/btn may change on every edge; there is no frame latching.
atoms.boundary: Only the fixed profile above; all inputs are known two-state values and satisfy setup and hold times; unsupported parameter configurations are not required.

atoms.description: n_rst low clears the top-level data/control/LEDs, filter outputs, window registers and pointers, text coordinates, and blink count and enable only on a rising edge; the threshold returns to 128, Gaussian mode to 1, Sobel mode to 0, and button counts/prev are cleared to 0. RAM contents are retained.
atoms.timing: Pulling n_rst low between edges does not immediately change outputs; after the reset rising edge, all outputs are 0; after release, the native pipeline resumes.
atoms.boundary: RAM is not initialized by reset; data from the first read of an unwritten slot is unspecified and must not be assumed to be 0.

atoms.description: sw[2:0] selects, in order, 0 original, 1 grayscale, 2 negative, 3 threshold, 4 Gaussian, 5 sharpen, 6 Sobel, 7 emboss. The seven filters run in parallel, and unselected paths still retain and update their states. Changes to sw do not wait for a frame boundary.
atoms.timing: Data and control are selected combinationally; the top level and text have different latencies, and values are taken according to their respective histories when switching.
atoms.boundary: The 8 paths must not be misinterpreted as paths with a uniform latency; history of unselected paths must not be cleared.

atoms.description: The threshold/Gaussian/Sobel free-running 22-bit counters increment from 0 on every edge, clear to 0 when the pre-edge value is 2500000, and sample the routed buttons, thus once every 2500001 non-reset edges. Only a sampled low-to-high transition triggers; a long press does not repeat; threshold btn0 adds 5 and btn1 subtracts 5, clamped to 0..255; simultaneous new rising transitions give increment priority, and both prev values are updated. Only sw3 routes to threshold, sw4/6 route to their respective btn0, and other routing is 0.
atoms.timing: The count does not restart based on the button level; an unsampled release does not form a new visible low state. Data on the update edge uses the old threshold.
atoms.boundary: Narrow pulses may be missed by sampling; top-level parameters cannot accelerate sampling; btn2/3 and btn1 for Gaussian/Sobel have no effect.

atoms.description: The two RAMs of W=384 in each window read the old mem[ptr] and write the new input to the same address on edges where VDE is high; ptr returns to 0 at W-1. lb2 writes the old lb1 output; on the same edge, p22 takes the input, p12 takes the old lb1 output, and p02 takes the old lb2 output, with each row shifting horizontally. Valid pixels u[k] correspond to p22=u[k],p21=u[k-1],p20=u[k-2],p12=u[k-W-1],p11=u[k-W-2],p10=u[k-W-3],p02=u[k-2W-2],p01=u[k-2W-3],p00=u[k-2W-4], valid only after the respective slots have been written.
atoms.timing: When VDE is low, the RAMs, pointers, windows, and line buffer outputs hold; hsync/vsync do not flush them. Filter outputs are computed from the old window on every edge.
atoms.boundary: Reset clears only the pointers, lb outputs, and windows; RAM is retained. Values in initially unwritten slots are unspecified. There is no padding, clearing of horizontal shifts at line ends, or frame flush.

atoms.description: Text x increments by 1 on edges where raw VDE is high, returns to 0 at 383, and clears to 0 when VDE is low. y clears to 0 on a raw vsync falling edge, taking priority over incrementing by 1 on a VDE falling edge, and wraps naturally at 11 bits. The box is x∈[16,383],y<48; the nine-character area contains, in order, NORMAL, GREYSCALE, NEGATIVE, THRESHOLD, GAUSSIAN, SHARPEN, SOBEL, EMBOSS, padded with spaces as needed. SCALE=5,PAD=4, tx=x-20, ty=y-4, computed with 11-bit coordinates; in_text additionally requires x/y>=4 within the box, tx<360, and ty<40; the character index is tx/40, the column within the character is (tx%40)/5, and the row is ty/5, selecting row bitmap[7-col]. Strokes are white, the remainder inside the box is black, and outside the box the selected pixel is used. The 8 rows of each character, from top to bottom, are hex bitmaps: A:3C/66/66/7E/66/66/66/00; B:7C/66/66/7C/66/66/7C/00; C:3C/66/60/60/60/66/3C/00; D:78/6C/66/66/66/6C/78/00; E:7E/60/60/7C/60/60/7E/00; G:3C/66/60/6E/66/66/3C/00; H:66/66/66/7E/66/66/66/00; I:3C/18/18/18/18/18/3C/00; L:60/60/60/60/60/60/7E/00; M:42/66/7E/5A/42/42/42/00; N:66/76/7E/6E/66/66/66/00; O:3C/66/66/66/66/66/3C/00; P:7C/66/66/7C/60/60/60/00; R:7C/66/66/7C/6C/66/66/00; S:3C/66/60/3C/06/66/3C/00; T:7E/18/18/18/18/18/18/00; U:66/66/66/66/66/66/3C/00; V:66/66/66/66/66/3C/18/00; Y:66/66/66/3C/18/18/18/00; all other characters are all 0.
atoms.timing: Text is registered on every edge, without VDE gating the data; coordinates and the selected pixel use pre-edge values. Synchronization controls do not pass through the text layer.
atoms.boundary: hsync does not participate in the coordinates, and IMAGE_HEIGHT64 does not limit y either; the text is actually in the upper-right corner; low VDE does not prohibit black background box output.

atoms.description: The independent top-level x updates according to raw VDE. When sw3=1, pre-edge x∈[191,193] has priority and outputs a white divider; otherwise, x>=192 outputs old text data, and the left side outputs the current input; when sw3=0, all output uses old text data. Controls always register the pre-edge selected controls. Outside the box in a stable mode, after edge n the raw path has data=P[n-1] while control=H[n]; single-pixel filtering has data=F(P[n-2]) while control=H[n-1].
atoms.timing: Top-level split-screen x, overlay coordinates, and data use their respective pre-edge states; no additional output alignment is guaranteed.
atoms.boundary: Do not assume that the left/right sides correspond to the same pixel cycle or that VDE and RGB are aligned; calculate window paths separately according to their recurrences.

atoms.description: When the pre-edge 26-bit blink count is >=6, clear it to 0 and toggle enable; otherwise increment it by 1. The LED uses the old enable on the same edge, and reflects the toggle only on the next edge; when on, sw[1:0]=0/1/2/3 corresponds to 0001/0010/0100/1000; when off, it is 0000, the same for both filter categories.
atoms.timing: The toggle interval is 7 non-reset edges, and a complete on/off cycle is 14 edges; reset clears the count, enable, and LED.
atoms.boundary: A mode change alters the one-hot selection in real time, but must not use the new enable early.
